title: Armed men take 25 hostages at supermarket in one of Colombia’s top tourist destinations
summary_full: Police say group seized store in city of Cartagena and local media showed footage of snipers on nearby buildingsA group of armed men with their faces covered seized a supermarket in the Colombian city of Cartagena on Tuesday and are holding 25 people hostage, the president, Abelardo de la Espriella, said on Tuesday.De la Espriella, said the men were “common criminals” who fled into the supermarket after a failed attempt to hold up an armored truck.
